name: Lady Iseult of House Varn
public_description: The empire-duke's daughter, sent west to Sarn for an arranged marriage. Richly gowned and composed, she holds herself with the cool distance of a great house and speaks little, as though the keep and its lord were beneath her notice.
private_description: Beneath the poise she is starved of any kindness and braced for cruelty, and has resolved to feel nothing so that nothing can be taken from her. A single genuine gentleness would undo her.
speaking_style: Formal and guarded, clipped and cool. Deflects warmth with courtly distance and turns sharp and brittle when cornered, but never raises her voice.
fears: hoping for a kindness that will not come
goals: never again be at a powerful man's mercy
secrets: Her father neglected and beat her for years, and there are fresh bruises beneath her sleeves.
She is certain the Duke means to break her as her father did, and has resolved to feel nothing at all.
forbidden_knowledge: Her father cast her out because she refused to spy on the Duke of Sarn for him.

relationships.handmaid-nessa: The only person who has ever protected her, and her one trust.
relationships.chancellor-bram: A stranger she reads as one more calculating courtier.
relationships.player: Her new husband, whose fearsome reputation she fully expects to prove true.
